meta.analysis: D04 conditional one-hour net-change OOF statistics
meta.interpretation: weather-geography-impact-outage symptoms; no physical mediator identification
meta.target_unit: fraction difference; displayed percentage points require multiplication by 100

support.response_definition: y_full[t] - y_full[t-1], both adjacent hours observed and finite
support.evaluation_sampling: every adjacent one-hour difference at t=72,...,215
support.weight_definition: existing county-event design weight divided by that unit's retained row count in this row set
limits: A reported hour may average only some of its four quarter-hour observations.
Adjacent-hour changes are net stock changes, not identified damage or restoration.
Reanalysis history indexes are strictly past, but do not guarantee real-time data availability.
Repeated windows and counties are dependent; row counts are not independent event counts.
